statement.ru: Галактику Андромеды можно увидеть без телескопа.
statement.en: You can see the Andromeda Galaxy without a telescope.

why: At magnitude 3.4 it is visible to the naked eye on moonless nights, 2.5 million light years away.

statement.ru: Астронавты оставили на Луне зеркала, в которые до сих пор светят лазером.
statement.en: Astronauts left mirrors on the Moon that are still hit with lasers today.

why: Apollo 11, 14 and 15 left retroreflectors; observatories still range them with lasers.

statement.ru: Телескоп изобрёл Галилей.
statement.en: Galileo invented the telescope.

why: The first record is a 1608 Dutch patent application by Hans Lipperhey; Galileo built his own in 1609 after hearing of it.

statement.ru: Облака Венеры состоят из серной кислоты.
statement.en: The clouds of Venus are made of sulphuric acid.

why: Venus's clouds are mainly (75-96%) droplets of sulphuric acid.

statement.ru: Звезду можно купить и официально назвать своим именем.
statement.en: You can buy a star and officially name it after yourself.

why: Star naming rights are not for sale via the IAU or any scientific body; commercial 'star names' are not recognised.

statement.ru: Плутон до сих пор официально считается планетой.
statement.en: Pluto is still officially counted as a planet.

why: In 2006 the IAU reclassified Pluto as a dwarf planet.

statement.ru: На Титане, спутнике Сатурна, идут дожди из жидкого метана.
statement.en: On Titan, a moon of Saturn, it rains liquid methane.

why: Huygens data show Titan's atmosphere periodically rains liquid methane onto its surface.

statement.ru: На Венере Солнце встаёт на западе.
statement.en: On Venus the Sun rises in the west.

why: Venus spins backwards (retrograde), so the Sun would rise in the west and set in the east.

statement.ru: Земля — самая плотная планета Солнечной системы.
statement.en: The Earth is the densest planet in the Solar System.

why: Earth's mean density, 5.51 g/cm3, is the highest of all the planets.

statement.ru: Солнце в конце жизни станет чёрной дырой.
statement.en: At the end of its life the Sun will become a black hole.

why: The Sun is too light for that: it will swell into a red giant and end as a white dwarf.

statement.ru: «Хьюстон, у нас проблема» сказал Нил Армстронг на Луне.
statement.en: Neil Armstrong said 'Houston, we have a problem' on the Moon.

why: It was said by Jack Swigert, then Jim Lovell, on Apollo 13, which never landed on the Moon.

statement.ru: С открытия Нептуна прошёл всего один нептунианский год.
statement.en: Only one Neptunian year has passed since Neptune was discovered.

why: Found in 1846, Neptune takes 164.8 years per orbit and completed its first one since discovery in July 2011.

statement.ru: Без скафандра в открытом космосе человек тут же взорвётся.
statement.en: Without a spacesuit in open space a person would explode at once.

why: The body may swell, but tissues are elastic enough to prevent rupture; one loses consciousness after 9 to 12 s.

statement.ru: Чайная ложка вещества нейтронной звезды весит миллиарды тонн.
statement.en: A teaspoon of neutron star matter weighs billions of tonnes.

why: A teaspoon of neutron star material would have a mass over 5.5×10^12 kg, about 5.5 billion tonnes.

statement.ru: «Хаббл» летает вокруг Земли дальше Луны.
statement.en: Hubble orbits the Earth farther out than the Moon.

why: Hubble is in low Earth orbit, about 500 km up; the Moon is about 384,000 km away.

statement.ru: Корабль в поясе астероидов неизбежно врежется в камень.
statement.en: A spaceship in the asteroid belt is bound to hit a rock.

why: The belt is mostly empty; many probes have crossed it safely, the odds of a hit are under 1 in a billion.

statement.ru: Растяжение тела у чёрной дыры учёные всерьёз зовут «спагеттификацией».
statement.en: Scientists really do call being stretched by a black hole 'spaghettification'.

why: Spaghettification is the astrophysics term for tidal stretching of objects into long thin shapes.

statement.ru: Спутник Юпитера Ганимед по размеру больше планеты Меркурий.
statement.en: Jupiter's moon Ganymede is bigger in size than the planet Mercury.

why: Ganymede is 5,268 km across, Mercury 4,880 km (though Mercury is heavier).

statement.ru: Граница космоса проходит в 1000 км над Землёй.
statement.en: The edge of space lies 1,000 km above the Earth.

why: The usual boundary, the Kármán line, is at 100 km, ten times lower.

statement.ru: Все трое астронавтов «Аполлона-11» гуляли по Луне.
statement.en: All three Apollo 11 astronauts walked on the Moon.

why: Only Armstrong and Aldrin landed; Michael Collins stayed in lunar orbit in Columbia.

statement.ru: NASA потратило миллионы долларов на ручку для космоса.
statement.en: NASA spent millions of dollars on a pen for space.

why: Fisher developed the space pen with private money; NASA bought about 400 of them at $2.95 each in 1967.

statement.ru: Солнечные пятна горячее остальной поверхности Солнца.
statement.en: Sunspots are hotter than the rest of the Sun's surface.

why: Sunspots are cooler, about 3,000 to 4,500 K against 5,780 K around them, which is why they look dark.

statement.ru: Солнце за год проходит через 13 созвездий.
statement.en: Over a year the Sun passes through 13 constellations.

why: The ecliptic crosses 13 constellations; the 13th is Ophiuchus, from about 29 November to 18 December.

statement.ru: Голубые звёзды горячее красных.
statement.en: Blue stars are hotter than red ones.

why: Blue O-type stars are above 33,000 K; red M-type stars are 2,300 to 3,900 K.

statement.ru: Звёзды мерцают из-за воздуха Земли.
statement.en: Stars twinkle because of the Earth's air.

why: Twinkling is caused by starlight passing through layers of turbulent atmosphere.

statement.ru: МКС большую часть времени летает без экипажа.
statement.en: The ISS flies without a crew most of the time.

why: The ISS has been continuously occupied since 2 November 2000.

statement.ru: Если Солнце заменить чёрной дырой той же массы, Земля упадёт в неё.
statement.en: If the Sun were replaced by a black hole of the same mass, the Earth would fall into it.

why: A black hole's external gravity is identical to any body of the same mass, so the Earth would keep its orbit.

statement.ru: Уран вращается, лёжа на боку.
statement.en: Uranus spins lying on its side.

why: Uranus's axis is tilted about 82-98 degrees, so it rolls along its orbit on its side.

statement.ru: Флаг на Луне развевался от ветра.
statement.en: The flag on the Moon was waving in the wind.

why: There is no air on the Moon; the flag hung from a rod and swung only while astronauts planted it.

statement.ru: Экипаж «Аполлона-13» погиб.
statement.en: The crew of Apollo 13 died.

why: After the oxygen tank blast the crew used the lunar module as a lifeboat and splashed down safely.

statement.ru: Астронавты оставили на Луне три автомобиля.
statement.en: Astronauts left three cars on the Moon.

why: The lunar rovers driven on Apollo 15, 16 and 17 were left behind: 'These three LRVs remain on the Moon.'

statement.ru: В Юпитер поместилось бы больше тысячи Земель.
statement.en: More than a thousand Earths would fit inside Jupiter.

why: Jupiter's volume is about 1,321 times the Earth's.

statement.ru: Луна — самый большой спутник в Солнечной системе.
statement.en: The Moon is the biggest moon in the Solar System.

why: Ganymede is the largest; the Moon is only fifth, after Ganymede, Titan, Callisto and Io.

statement.ru: На Юпитере можно встать на твёрдую поверхность.
statement.en: On Jupiter you could stand on a solid surface.

why: Jupiter is a gas giant: its gas turns gradually into liquid with depth, with no solid surface to stand on.

statement.ru: МКС можно увидеть с Земли просто глазами.
statement.en: You can see the ISS from Earth with the naked eye.

why: The ISS is visible to the naked eye as a bright moving white dot, mostly at twilight.

statement.ru: Ракета «Сатурн-5» была выше статуи Свободы.
statement.en: The Saturn V rocket was taller than the Statue of Liberty.

why: Saturn V stood 111 m (363 ft); the Statue of Liberty is 93 m from the ground to the torch, pedestal included (Wikipedia, Statue of Liberty).

statement.ru: Световой меч Люка Скайуокера со съёмок побывал в космосе.
statement.en: Luke Skywalker's lightsaber from the film set has been to space.

why: Mark Hamill's Return of the Jedi lightsaber prop flew to the ISS and back on Discovery's STS-120 in 2007.

statement.ru: Название «Плутон» придумала 11-летняя школьница.
statement.en: The name Pluto was thought up by an 11-year-old schoolgirl.

why: Venetia Burney of Oxford suggested the name in 1930, aged 11.

statement.ru: Хвост кометы всегда тянется позади неё.
statement.en: A comet's tail always trails behind it.

why: The tail points away from the Sun, inbound or outbound, so a comet leaving the Sun flies tail first.

statement.ru: Марсоход Curiosity работает на солнечных батареях.
statement.en: The Curiosity rover runs on solar panels.

why: Curiosity is powered by a plutonium-238 radioisotope generator, not solar panels, so it works day and night.

statement.ru: Через 12 тысяч лет Полярной звездой станет Вега.
statement.en: In 12,000 years Vega will become the North Star.

why: Precession moves the celestial pole: Vega will be the northern pole star around the year 13,700, as it was around 12,000 BC.

statement.ru: Спутники Марса зовут Страх и Ужас.
statement.en: The moons of Mars are named Fear and Dread.

why: Phobos and Deimos are Greek for fear/panic and terror/dread, the sons of Ares.

statement.ru: В среднем ближе всего к Земле — Меркурий, а не Венера.
statement.en: On average the planet closest to the Earth is Mercury, not Venus.

why: Averaged over time, Mercury is most often the closest planet to Earth (and to every other planet).

statement.ru: Солнечное затмение случается в полнолуние.
statement.en: A solar eclipse happens at full moon.

why: A solar eclipse can only happen at new moon, when the Moon is between the Sun and the Earth.

statement.ru: Солнечная система находится в самом центре Млечного Пути.
statement.en: The Solar System sits right at the centre of the Milky Way.

why: The Sun orbits the galactic centre 24,000 to 28,000 light years away from it.

statement.ru: Луна вращается вокруг своей оси.
statement.en: The Moon spins on its own axis.

why: The Moon turns once on its axis per orbit, which is why it always shows us the same side.

statement.ru: Кольца Сатурна — это сплошные твёрдые диски.
statement.en: Saturn's rings are solid discs.

why: The rings are countless separate pieces of ice, from dust grains to chunks metres across.

statement.ru: Звёзды одного созвездия всегда находятся рядом друг с другом.
statement.en: The stars of one constellation are always close to each other.

why: They only look close from Earth; they usually lie at very different distances from us.

statement.ru: На лунное затмение можно смотреть без защитных очков.
statement.en: You can watch a lunar eclipse without protective glasses.

why: Lunar eclipses are safe to observe without eye protection, unlike solar ones.

statement.ru: Марс красный, потому что покрыт ржавчиной.
statement.en: Mars is red because it is covered in rust.

why: Its red-orange colour comes from iron(III) oxide, i.e. rust, in its dust and rocks.
